title: High Park Residence
price: Sold at $2.9M - highest in the entire development
text: A challenging sale that needed persistence, constant buyer feedback and disciplined repositioning. I ran more than 40 viewings and kept refining the marketing until the right buyer came along. It sold at $2.9M, the highest transaction price across the development at the time.

title: 28 Pasir Ris Avenue
text: After a long time on the market, we moved from simply advertising to a clear pricing and negotiation plan. Grounding the talks in market evidence, qualifying serious landed buyers and fitting the deal to the sellers' onward plans led to a sale close to $6M.
